sourcePlainText: Tourist Vehicle Rental in Nepal Planning a trip to Nepal? We provide reliable, comfortable, and affordable tourist vehicle rental in Nepal, serving travelers, trekkers, and tour groups across the country. Whether you need a private vehicle hire in Nepal, a car rental with driver, or a tourist bus rental for a large group, our fleet is built to handle every kind of Nepal journey from Kathmandu city sightseeing to remote Himalayan trekking routes. Our Nepal tourist vehicle service includes everything from compact cars and 4WD jeep rentals for Upper Mustang and Muktinath, to spacious Hiace vans and Coaster buses for group tours to Pokhara, Chitwan, and Lumbini. Need a smooth ride to the mountains? Our 4WD jeeps are trek-ready for the Everest Base Camp Trek and Annapurna regions trekking. Looking for comfort and prestige? Choose from our luxury tourist vehicles, including Toyota Land Cruisers and premium SUVs. Every vehicle comes with a professional, licensed driver who knows Nepal's roads, routes, and destinations inside out. We also offer dependable Kathmandu airport transfers, Kathmandu-to-Pokhara and Kathmandu-to-Chitwan private transport, and full-service Nepal trekking transportation support. From solo travelers to large families and tour groups, we deliver safe, affordable, and professional tourist transportation across Nepal book your vehicle today and travel Nepal with total peace of mind. What type of tourist vehicle in Nepal ? During the visit in Nepal, your travel agency Nepal Unique Treks will provide you type of tourist vhicle according to your group size, Here's a breakdown of the main types of tourist vehicles used in Nepal, organized by category useful both as travel info and as content for a dedicated Vehicle Types. 1. Cars / Sedans Toyota Corolla, Suzuki Swift Dzire, Hyundai Accent for small families or couples, city sightseeing, and short point-to-point trips (e.g., Kathmandu airport transfers, Kathmandu Valley tours) 2. SUVs / Jeeps (4WD) Mahindra Scorpio, Bolero, Toyota Land Cruiser, Tata Sumo essential for rough mountain roads and off-the-beaten-path routes Used for: Upper Mustang, Muktinath, Jomsom, Rara Lake, remote trekking trailheads 4WD capability is a must for high-altitude, unpaved, or landslide-prone roads 3. Vans Toyota Hiace (9–12 seater) the most popular mid-size option for small groups and families Comfortable for medium-distance travel like Kathmandu to Pokhara, Kathmandu to Chitwan, or airport pickups for groups 4. Mini Buses / Micro Buses 16–20 seater mini coasters ideal for medium-sized tour groups, school/college groups, or corporate trips 5. Tourist Coaster Buses Coaster buses (25–32 seater) used for larger group tours, especially popular tourist circuits like Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan to Lumbini 6. Large Tourist Buses Full-size buses (40+ seater) for big tour groups, pilgrimage tours, or large international delegations 7. Luxury Vehicles Land Cruiser Prado, luxury SUVs, premium Hiace for VIP travelers, honeymooners, or business travelers wanting extra comfort 8.
